scientific_status: post-inspection causal retrospective development for a prospective logging contract; not validation

sealed_data_status.reason: The common provider files extend through 2026-06-29, but repository research outputs already span 2026 and no seal predating these hypotheses exists.

causal_admission_features.admission_bar: provider row matched by anchor start_timestamp plus frozen breakout entry_step
causal_admission_features.admission_state: the frozen causal state assignment covering the admission bar
causal_admission_features.orientation_survived_to_admission: the anchor state run still covers the admission bar; no intervening transition
causal_admission_features.regime_age_bars: admission ordinal minus current run start ordinal plus one
causal_admission_features.duration_percentile: percentile of admission age within 2024 non-terminal completed durations for the admission state
causal_admission_features.exit_before_frozen_close_hazard: empirical 2024 state-specific P(duration < required age at frozen close | duration >= admission age), excluding session-terminal right-censored runs
causal_admission_features.atr14: mean true range of the 14 completed bars strictly before admission
forbidden: realized current-run duration as a feature

payoff_path.primary_final_payoff: frozen gross return bps minus 10 bps
payoff_path.path_window: admission bar through the already-frozen anchor+24 close
payoff_path.mfe: directional best high/low excursion from frozen entry price
payoff_path.mae: directional worst low/high excursion from frozen entry price
payoff_path.atr_normalization: excursion price distance divided by admission ATR14

path_classes.timing_failure: net final payoff <= 0 and gross MFE > 10 bps
path_classes.no_usable_move: net final payoff <= 0 and gross MFE <= 10 bps

payoff_path.intrabar_caveat: Entry-bar MAE ordering is not observable from OHLC; post-entry-bar excursions are reported separately and are the conservative diagnostic.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Separate forecasts whose anchor regime survives until fill from forecasts already invalidated by a transition.
hypotheses.safety_risk: Using realized total duration would leak; only state known at admission and elapsed age are features.
hypotheses.stop_condition: No consistent payoff separation across both opened periods and both candidates.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Identify whether regime maturity and inability to survive the payoff window explain losing occurrences.
hypotheses.safety_risk: Hazard tuning on scored periods; prevented by a fixed 2024-only estimator and fixed bins.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Hazard/payoff association changes sign or is economically negligible across candidate-period cells.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Distinguish wrong fixed-exit timing from absence of a cost-clearing move.
hypotheses.safety_risk: OHLC intrabar ordering ambiguity; conservative post-entry path is reported.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Losses predominantly have no cost-clearing MFE and no stable earlier path advantage.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Show whether any phase/path result belongs to the frozen orientation rather than the parent loop generically.
hypotheses.safety_risk: Controls are descriptive, not randomized or prospective.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Matched opposite orientations show equal or stronger effects.

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across the four candidate x period hazard association endpoints
inference.primary_mechanism_endpoint: AUC of negative exit hazard for positive net payoff; 0.5 is null

payoff_timing_feature_supported_for_logg: at least 50 rows in every candidate x period cell
negative-hazard payoff AUC is above 0.5 in all four cells
all four one-sided hazard endpoints pass Holm at 0.05
the orientation-survival payoff difference is positive in all four cells
leave-one-stock-out signs are stable for at least 16 of 20 deletions in every candidate x period cell
